description: This file implements the SubstitutionPattern class and its methods, used for parsing and handling substitution patterns in build configurations, specifically within the GN build system.

classes.name: SubstitutionPattern
classes.description: Represents a pattern with substitution ranges used for build path manipulations.

classes.name: Subrange
classes.description: Represents a segment of a substitution pattern, either literal text or a substitution token.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a string into substitution ranges, validating patterns.

methods.name: AsString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the substitution pattern.

methods.name: FillRequiredTypes
methods.description: Fills in the required substitution types based on the pattern.

methods.name: IsInOutputDir
methods.description: Checks if the pattern expands to a path within the output directory.
